adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, the Dialog is controlled via `open={isOpenDialog}` and `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` with no wrapper to reset local state on close. The only places that reset `setIsInvalidEmail(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])` are the Cancel button handler and `addGuestsMutation.onSuccess`. If the user closes the dialog via backdrop click/Escape, `setIsOpenDialog(false)` runs but `isInvalidEmail` and `multiEmailValue` remain unchanged, so reopening can immediately show the prior error banner and stale inputs.
